title: Mobility Equipment Field Service Standard — Battery-Bay Handling Allowance
content:
# Battery-Bay Handling Allowance — Mobility Equipment

**Standard.** A battery-bay handling allowance is added to the labor units claimed from the manufacturer for a warranty battery-set replacement on a Mobility Equipment chair, by the chair's loaner and home-assessment records: 3 units when no loaner chair has been delivered for the chair and two or more in-home accessibility assessments are recorded on it, 2 units when no loaner chair has been delivered for it and exactly one in-home accessibility assessment is recorded, and nothing in any other case.

## Records read

- **Loaner deliveries** — deliveries in the chair's service history whose purpose is a loaner chair.
- **In-home accessibility assessments** — assessment visits recorded on the chair, whatever their result.

## Combinations

| Loaner chair delivered for the chair | In-home accessibility assessments recorded | Battery-bay handling allowance |
|---|---|---|
| none | 2 or more | 3 units |
| none | exactly 1 | 2 units |
| none | none | none |
| one or more | any number | none |

## Hypothetical cases

- A power chair assessed twice at the home before delivery and repaired without a loaner: 3 units.
- The same chair, but a loaner chair was delivered while it was in for repair: none.
